reading: of 4950 typed non-reference candidates in the deployed top-20, 408 carry the same transformation type as a true metabolite on their own substrate. That is the hard-negative signal and, identically, the PU risk: each is a same-type-different-site product, which is what an unannotated true metabolite looks like. A large share means a hard-negative scheme has much to reject and much to wrongly reject; a small one means little of either.
